    docs/evidence/interfaces-eth-pnr2-postcts-config.json: 5 (int)
  
  OpenROAD computes the derate factor in Tcl integer arithmetic. An int 5 derates by
  0 % and logs "Setting timing derate to: 5%" while doing it; 5.0 derates by 5 %. docs/72
  section 7.1 measured the difference at 1.744 ns and 1.623 ns on one step, which is
  larger than most of the timing findings in this repository.
assert not [('docs/evidence/interfaces-eth-pnr2-postcts-config.json', 5)]
